name: Hizuki Ruka
source:
"I want to get closer to him."

He admires "Ichiya", a former idol (currently a producer) who graduated from "Saint Raphael Academy". Hearing rumors that he could make his debut in the entertainment industry produced by Ichiya at the school, he entered the academy with slightly impure motives, saying, "Maybe I'll be able to meet Ichiya-san!"

However, he is a boy who genuinely likes to sing and dance, and he does his best in everything he does.

Hobby: Snowboarding, Soccer
Favorite Foods: Meat buns and grilled meat
Dislikes: Celery

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040207001129/http://www.will-game.com/BCM/gb01/char02.htm]official website[/url]]
